reproducibility_gaps: No dependency/environment manifest, Python version, or package versions are supplied; README installation guidance only adds the embedded pyCaMOtk directory to PYTHONPATH.
The drivers select CPU when CUDA is unavailable, but the assessed source contains 32 hard-coded CUDA transfers, so the advertised fallback is not an implemented CPU path.

Element-based graph construction does not derive adjacency within each finite element, while both Navier-Stokes drivers deliberately construct self-loop-only subgraphs; these conflict with the paper's mesh-adjacency graph description.
Only the two Poisson drivers set torch.manual_seed(0); the four elasticity/Navier-Stokes configurations have no established initialization seed.
No trained checkpoint, archived log, numeric result table, tolerance file, or machine-readable paper target is bundled.
The circular forward driver enters an active debugger after writing outputs, and all entrypoints depend on execution from their own directory plus manual source/PYTHONPATH setup.
The bundled MATLAB mesh was not opened under the static boundary, and paper-reported results were not recomputed.
notes: R1 preserves complete source, license, bundled small inputs, six entrypoints, equations, architectures, and paper targets while withholding a source-to-result reconstruction claim.
No scientific workload was executed; R5 remains prohibited.
